checks.title: sm-ui pinned to an exact version (no range, no github: ref, no latest). [A, N, S]
sm-ui pinned version equals the newest published tag, or a declared exception. [N deviation; A warns only]
package-lock.json committed and consistent (npm ci succeeds). [A, N, S]
The workflow installs with npm ci, never npm install. [A, N]
Secrets the workflows reference exist on the repo (PACKAGES, SM_API_KEY). [N, S]
Kit-adopted per Q7: pack files present at the fleet version, ruleset requires ci-gate, sm-workflow-drift, codeowner-gate, ai-review-gate, commit-identity, auto-merge on. [N, S]
portal.json present with template name, template_version at or above the standard's minimum, type and modules. [A, N, S]

Layout, Login, PageGate come from @sprint-mode/sm-ui; no local component named like an sm-ui export (Layout, Login, AccountSwitcher, PortalPicker, NotificationBellNav, PageGate, PortalSupportWidget, ProfileCard). [A, N]
The login route renders sm-ui Login with portal="<slug>"; no local call to /auth/magic or /auth/verify-code. [A, N, S]
No local role-list constant (SM_TEAM_ROLES, BUILT_IN_ROLES or a literal list of team role keys); is_sm_team and roles come from the session. [A, N]
View-as is either off or wired to an explicit viewAsApi feed served by the population endpoint. [A, N]
data-product on html equals the portal slug. [A, N, S]

When the slug is not in sm-ui's known map, the html[data-product] override block is present with --accent, --accent-hover, --accent-foreground, --accent-10, --accent-20, --accent-tint and the dark tint. [A, N, S]
No hardcoded hex colors or font-family in the portal's own CSS or JSX where a token exists (allowlist: the override block, SVG fills). [A warns; N deviation]
portal_configs has brand_color, brand_tint and the five logo URLs, and the five R2 objects answer HEAD 200. [N, S]
Every prerendered public route serves a title, a description and og:image; a legacy SPA portal is a deviation labeled "SPA shell, no SEO" with a standing override per portal. [N]
Prerendered HTML exists in production for every route in portal.json.public_routes. [N]
portal_roles carries the nine team roles including super_admin with the fleet display names, and the customer roles match the type's list or a declared list. [N, S]
No active portal_members row belongs to a person whose contacts.status is inactive or whose employment_status is former; a departed person is a status, never a name list. [N]
The portal is registered in the Team Roles matrix with super_admin granted. [N, S]
The CF Pages project exists, is git-connected to the portal's repo, and its production branch is main (or the branch portal.json declares). [N, S]
Every custom_domain in portal_configs is attached to the project and active. [N]
The production main JS asset is application/javascript and larger than 100 KB. [N]
The canonical production deployment SHA equals the head of main. [N]
portal_sections is non-empty and equals the app's declared permkeys (the sync ran). [N, S]
The functions/ passthrough sets X-SM-Product to the slug; no root or public _worker.js. [A, N]
The portal's page gate reads the /auth/me shape the spine actually returns ({ ok, user }); a gate that tests data.data alone is a deviation. [A, N, S]

/api/portal/config resolves for the portal's own origins (each allowed domain plus the sprintmode.ai host): ok=true and config.name equals the portal name [N, and the sm-api deploy smoke; today's Safe Shepherd logo regression]
No browser-side call to an auth host other than the spine (api.sprintmode.ai or the portal's own /api/sm proxy); a page that calls another origin for a session is a deviation [A warns, N]
